channel.title: Said & Checked: Defense and National Security — AskAmerica
channel.description: What officeholders said each day about Defense and National Security, and which statements government data supports, contradicts or rules out.

item.title: Said & Checked, Defense and National Security, 2026-11-20: none false or contradicted, 1 unsupported, 5 unsettled (Donald Trump, Markwayne Mullin, Dan Goldman)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsupported and Unsettled

  • Donald Trump, President of the United States: “Reported as: They also agree that Iran cannot obtain a nuclear weapon, Trump said.” Unsupported. No Chinese record found says China agrees Iran cannot obtain a nuclear weapon. China's summit readout and the joint declaration speak of preventing the proliferation of nuclear weapons in general and do not name Iran. Searched: the two Chinese Foreign Ministry readouts of Nov. 19, the joint declaration and AP's report; Xinhua could not be loaded, and no Chinese-language record was searched.
  • Markwayne Mullin, Secretary of Homeland Security: “Reported as: Mullin said the threat was not imminent.” Unsettled. No on-record FBI, intelligence-community or DHS assessment of the plot's imminence, other than the secretary's own testimony, was found. A White House statement said there were "no credible threats to the homeland," and CNN's unnamed sources described the planning as "an effort to give itself options rather than an indicator of an imminent attack"; nothing found describes it as imminent.
  • Dan Goldman, U.S. Representative from New York: “have decimated the cybersecurity personnel that this administration entered office with” Unsettled. OPM headcount data in AskAmerica's warehouse show CISA's workforce fell from 3,379 in January 2025 to 2,197 in September 2026, about 35%, while the FBI as a whole fell from 37,107 to 35,427, about 4.5%. No series isolates FBI cybersecurity staff, so the FBI part cannot be measured, and "decimated" has no fixed threshold.

item.title: Said & Checked, Defense and National Security, 2026-11-19: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Marco Rubio)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Marco Rubio, Secretary of State: “Reported as: Rubio told reporters there was "zero" evidence that the outages were connected or were tied to rival nations, cyber hackers or criminals.” Unsettled. The accounts found for each outage are non-malicious and none links them: Microsoft cites a latent software defect, JPMorgan Chase "a software bug" that "is not cyber-related," the NSA "temporary degradation during scheduled routine maintenance," and the FAA network data flooding. The NSA gave no further cause, the FAA account was not read from its primary document in this check, and Microsoft's final report was still pending, so the evidence does not fully decide the claim.

item.title: Said & Checked, Defense and National Security, 2026-11-18: none false or contradicted, 1 unsupported, 1 unsettled (Mark Kelly, Markwayne Mullin)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsupported and Unsettled

  • Mark Kelly, U.S. Senator from Arizona: “One parent told us that there's their kid, lost more than 45 pounds in six months because of a lack of food” Unsupported. Military.com's hearing report confirms Kelly said at the Nov. 17 hearing that a parent reported a child losing more than 45 pounds in six months. Searched: the AskAmerica catalog (no table covers it), Military.com, the PBS and Yahoo copies of the live blog, and an NPR interview from August 2026 in which Kelly described a different case (a grandmother, 20 to 25 pounds); no hearing transcript, press release or published report of the parent's account itself was found.
  • Markwayne Mullin, Secretary of Homeland Security: “Reported as: Mullin said the UK doesn't have the same safeguards and emergency preparedness the U.S has.” Unsettled. No common measure ranks U.S. and U.K. emergency preparedness; the warehouse holds U.S.-only FEMA tables and no U.K. data. The one comparable measure found, household-supply advice, exists in both countries (U.K. 72 hours; Ready.gov 'several days'). The U.K. government page was not read.

item.title: Said & Checked, Defense and National Security, 2026-11-17: none false or contradicted, 1 unsettled (Donald Trump)
item.description:
No statement was found false or contradicted.

Unsettled

  • Donald Trump, President of the United States: “Nobody's proven that she's a spy.” Unsettled. No charge or court filing against the woman was found. AP relays a New York Times report that U.S. intelligence concluded she was a Chinese agent; that conclusion is unpublished and could not be read directly, so whether an official finding exists is not settled.
